title: Notes on Live Streaming (1): How Platforms Turn Street Tips into Big Business
summary: After weeks watching virtual singing streams on Bilibili and scraping data across 20 rooms, I wrote a four-part series on how the money actually flows. Part 1 examines how platforms use zero-cost digital rules to turn capped street tips into a massive business.
